from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentMatch(BaseModel):
    """A single document mapped to its assigned legal case category."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The full title of the legal document")
    case_type: str = Field(description="The specific legal case category this document belongs to, matching the provided task list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentMatch]
